title: Deactivating a sales rep with no customer assignments applies silently with no dialog
permissions_required: Owner/Administrator/Manager profile (or equivalent custom role) with staff administration.
preconditions: 1. A ZZAUTOTEST staff member is active with the sales-rep toggle ON and NO customers assigned to them as sales rep.
steps: 1. Edit the staff member in staff administration and toggle their active status off.
expected: 1. The deactivation applies silently — no warning dialog is shown.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
notes: Restore the staff member afterwards. The precondition check behind this branch is covered by SBR-API-06.
